_comment: Which artifact owns which schema. The ONLY place the mapping from 'this object is missing' to 'run this' is written down. Read by scripts/validate_app_views.py (--repair runs `action`) and by the SA app (lib/missing-dependency.ts turns a 'does not exist' query error into `fix`). `action` is a CALL, @FILE:<path relative to scripts/> or @PACK:<fleet pack>. `fix` is operator-facing; when omitted it is derived from `action`. `note` says what the layer depends on and, where true, that the admin app cannot produce it.

entries.label: Catchment
entries.note: Built from the Overture Places and Addresses data for the region. It is not produced by the admin app Data Studio.

entries.label: Location diagnostics (Site Impact, Closure Impact)
fix: CALL FLEET_INTELLIGENCE.CATCHMENT.BUILD_CATCHMENT('{region}', TRUE);  -- only if catchment is missing
entries.note: Needs Overture POIs and household addresses for the region (the catchment layer). It is not produced by the admin app Data Studio; there is no Location dataset generator.
